ja388:1.1: Navachandake dāni diyyati, puṇṇāyaṃ doṇī, suvāminī ṭhitā, bahuke jane pāsapāṇike, no ca kho me paṭibhāti bhuñjitun
ja388:2.1: ti. Tasasi bhamasi lenam icchasi attāṇo si kuhiṃ gamissasi, appossukko bhuñja Tuṇḍila, maṃsatthāya hi posiyāmase.
ja388:3.1: Ogaha rahadaṃ akaddamaṃ, sabbaṃ sedamalaṃ pavāhaya, gaṇhāhi navaṃ vilepanaṃ yassa gandho na kadāci chijjatīti.
ja388:4.1: Katamo rahado akaddamo, kiṃ su sedamalan ti vuccati, katamañ ca navaṃ vilepanaṃ yassa gandho na kadāci chijjatīti.
ja388:5.1: Dhammo rahado akaddamo, pāpaṃ sedamalan ti vuccati, sīlañ ca navaṃ vilepanaṃ, tassa gandho na kadāci chijjati.
ja388:6.1: Nandanti sarīraghātino, na ca nandanti sarīradhārino, puṇṇāya ca puṇṇamāsiyā ramamānā va jahanti jīvitan ti
